about: The full-quality guard's hashes after an assistant stopped being told a time the app marks as a guess. The export tool's reply (section C) no longer says how long the export is expected to take when that time is a guess from the size of the export (a sentence ending 'A rough guess: ...'); when the time comes from this PC's own earlier exports the reply is as it was. Only the words of the reply's note differ: the command, the plan and everything else handed to the app process are the same, and so are sections A, B and D. reachedKeys lists the keys whose reply carried a guess before the change (read from the print notes of the unchanged tree): exactly those keys differ between the two fixtures. exportFullGuard.uhd60.sha256.json is the record before the change and is kept untouched; this file was printed (print mode, never edited) from the tree after the change, and exportFullGuard.test.ts compares the two files key by key.
